name: Brescia University
academic_ranking: Private, four-year Catholic liberal arts institution founded by the Ursuline Sisters of Mount Saint Joseph. Small enrollment (roughly 550 undergraduates, ~690 total, fall 2023-2024). Known for small class sizes and programs in business, education, social work, and pre-professional/health tracks. No specific national ranking confirmed from primary sources.
financial_aid: Published 2024-25 undergraduate cost is approximately $31,550 per year ($30,500 base tuition plus ~$1,050 required fees), per third-party aggregators (univstats, collegefactual). As a private NAIA institution Brescia offers institutional academic scholarships, need-based aid, and athletic aid; specific award amounts were not published on public pages checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Softball is part of Brescia Bearcats athletics in Owensboro, KY. Specific softball facility/field details were not published on the public softball pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NAIA program competing in the River States Conference. Public roster and staff pages confirmed an active program with a full 18-player 2025-26 roster and a two-person coaching staff (head coach plus one assistant). No conference-championship or ranking claims verified from primary sources.
notes: Data captured 2026-07-30 from live bresciabearcats.com pages (correct softball path is /sports/sball/). Note: the athletics CDN intermittently served stale Ohio Dominican University content under a Brescia-titled shell; cache-busted requests returned the correct Brescia data, which is what is reported here. Coaching staff directory (/sports/sball/coaches/index) listed exactly two softball staff: Traci Smith (Head Coach) and Greg Tanner (Assistant Coach); no recruiting coordinator, player-development director, GA, or volunteer positions were listed. Roster size (18) is from the most recent populated roster, 2025-26 (/sports/sball/2025-26/roster); the 2026-27 roster page exists but was empty/not yet posted. Conference (River States) and NAIA affiliation confirmed via Wikipedia. Tuition confirmed via two independent aggregators (univstats, collegefactual); brescia.edu and NCES/CollegeScorecard blocked or did not return dollar figures.
